canada.title: Another round of water restrictions starts as Calgary's replacement pipe nears finish line

canada.title: The fate of a tied council race for Norfolk County’s Ward 4 may be left up to chance

canada.title: New Brunswick's plan to build new housing fast is costing a fortune, but it's working

canada.title: Community comes together to support residents displaced by Shediac apartment fire

canada.title: Future of two wharfs in Queens County village uncertain
canada.summary: Hunts Point locals say many rely on the wharfs to work from and it's a big draw for tourists when they visit. But with the federal government's upcoming closures to the infrastructure, this leaves the village and the fishers unsure of the future of their community.

canada.title: Lantz residents face flooding risk as $2M culvert fix awaits political resolution

canada.title: Polar bear pit stop poses problems for Sachs Harbour, N.W.T.
canada.summary: Officials say between seven and nine polar bears have been visiting the garbage dump in the hamlet, but it’s the humans looking to see a polar bear up close that pose the safety risk.

canada.title: Fuel costs force Sunday mass out of historical Fort Smith cathedral
canada.summary: Sunday mass is relocating out of St. Joseph's Cathedral in Fort Smith, N.W.T., for the winter starting this upcoming weekend after a decision made by the parish council. Instead, Sunday service will be delivered at the parish's family centre at usual mass time, though it will still be possible to hold funerals and Christmas services in the cathedral.

canada.title: Marine Atlantic expecting very busy 2027, with bookings way ahead of this time last year

canada.title: IPV survivor says 'life could have been in jeopardy' because of abuser's release
canada.summary: A survivor of intimate partner violence says no one told her in advance that her attacker was out of prison, even though she was registered with Victim Services. The Department of Justice and Public Safety won't comment on the specific case but says, if a victim has asked for information about an inmate's release, "attempts will be made to inform the victim."

canada.title: An Ontario councillor allegedly threatened a mayoral candidate. Now both are set to serve alongside each other
canada.summary: The incoming mayor of Clarington, Ont., will take office alongside a councillor who has been criminally charged with uttering threats against him, raising questions about how council will navigate the matter.

canada.title: 'Things have to change now': Montreal groups demand systemic reform after police firings
canada.summary: Montreal community members are welcoming the unprecedented dismissal of seven police officers over allegations of racist and discriminatory behaviour, but say the move is not enough. Advocates are calling for systemic reforms, greater accountability and a public inquiry.

canada.title: UBC prof testifies she acted as a 'conduit' for sex assault allegations against Steven Galloway
canada.summary: Anabel Lyon, director of the University of British Columbia's school of creative writing, said she believed the unfounded accusations of a former student who accused bestselling author Steven Galloway of sexual assault.

canada.title: New Alberta bill would compel ‘neutrality’ for post-secondary institutions on political issues

desks.summary: Democrat Aaron Ford won election Wednesday as governor of Nevada, defeating Republican incumbent Joe Lombardo. Ford, the attorney general, defeated the incumbent Lombardo in what was considered one of the country's most competitive governor's races. Ford ran with the backing of the Democratic congressional delegation, California Gov. Gavin Newsom and former Vice President Kamala Harris. He focused his winning campaign on affordability issues and blamed President Donald Trump and Lombardo for Nevadans' economic woes. He easily dispatched a more progressive challenger in the primary, insisting the party's left wing doesn’t represent all Democrats. Ford will be the state's first Black governor.
